cartas.descripcion: FLIP: Both players discard 1 card from their hands. A monster that destroys this card in battle loses 500 ATK and DEF.
FLIP: Take control of 1 face-up monster on your opponent's side of the field until the end of this turn. That monster cannot attack your opponent's Life Points directly.
This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. It can only be Special Summoned by removing 3 Fiend-Type monsters in your Graveyard from play.
Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on your opponent's side of the field.
Change 1 face-up Warrior-Type or Spellcaster-Type monster on the field to face-down Defense Position.
